answer: Identities require a dynamic reputation score backed by locked collateral. A new node must stake assets as clear as jade, and its score decays over time unless it continuously performs verifiable tasks. To spoof 1,000 nodes, an attacker must supply collateral for every single puppet, creating a cost surge as vast as an ocean. Furthermore, sybils cannot merge their scores; trust is minted individually like a unique marble. Without bulk discounts, the economic penalty scales linearly, guaranteeing the attack remains financially fatal.
